Know what every referrer earns. Get reports out faster.

Referrer commissions tracked on every bill, samples barcoded from collection to delivery, and results verified before release, so patients get their reports faster.

  • Referrer commission calculated on every bill, with a statement per referrer
  • Barcode and QR on every sample, from collection to delivery
  • Quality control before any report is released
  • Every branch, and every corporate or credit account, on one system

QuestionsFive that stop a buyer

The questions that stop a buyer, answered plainly.

Is this a full hospital system or just appointments?

Both, stated honestly. Appointments is live today and free to start. The other seventeen modules are defined and being built with founding facilities as early access. Book a demo and we will show you what is live, what is next, and a timeline set with you.

Why not a cheaper chamber tool?

A chamber tool runs one doctor's desk. Lofi Care runs the whole facility: the front desk, the lab, billing, referrers, and the owner's view of the day. A doctor who starts free on appointments is already on that system, so nothing has to be replaced later.

Is my data safe?

Data is held on servers in Bangladesh, in line with the country's data protection rules. Every sensitive action is written to an append-only audit trail that even the owner cannot edit. We do not claim certifications we do not hold.

How long does it take to get started?

Appointments: today. We set up your chamber and send your booking link. The platform: on a timeline we set together after the demo, module by module, starting with what your facility needs most.

Can I try it before I commit?

Yes. Start free on appointments with your first 500 appointments and no card. For the platform, the demo is a working session on your own workflows, with no obligation.
